payload.prompt: Goal: Get the 480 V switchgear package for Project Alpha ordered by 2027-03-15 within budget ₹4.6 Cr. Plan: takeoff, RFQ to 3 vendors, schedule and budget check per vendor, decision memo, human approval, PO. Risks: 1) Switchgear manufacturing lead time (16-24 weeks) vs on-site date 2027-07-30; 2) Copper-linked price volatility and short quote validity; 3) Vendor non-response to RFQ; 4) Drawing vs equipment-schedule discrepancies in the spec; 5) Human approvals close to the order-by date. Return

value.rationale: Work backwards from the order-by date 2027-03-15: quantities first, then competitive quotes from 3 vendors, each checked against the on-site date with CPM and against the ₹4.60 Cr budget. A ranked decision memo goes to the project manager before any PO is released.
mitigations: Compute CPM float per vendor; prefer on-time options and price expedite offers before deciding.
Refresh every quote before evaluation and re-check budget on any revision.
Retry RFQs up to 3 times with escalating follow-up; never block on one vendor.
Schedule governs; surface takeoff warnings as RFIs with the source page.
Request vendor selection approval by 2027-03-08 with a ranked decision memo.
